description: Every tree of height omega with every finite level finite has a cofinal branch. No unique-root hypothesis is required.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.konig.{u} (T : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.Tree)
  (hheight : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.treeHeight T = Ordinal.omega 0)
  (hfinite : ∀ (n : ℕ), (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level T ↑n).Finite) :
  ∃ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsCofinalBranch T B
